title: The symptom: orders and units short

claim: 23 of the 29 open orders at the Pune DC due in the coming week have a line on backorder (79.3%): 1,730 units across 22 SKUs, worth INR 5,650,370 on backorder.

statement: The shortage is concentrated in particular suppliers

title: Where the shortage sits, by supplier_id

claim: Short units by supplier_id: S-14 (Voltix Power Components): 950 units, 54.9%; S-21 (Chronofit Wearables): 155 units, 9.0%; S-07 (SoundWave Acoustics Co.): 120 units, 6.9%.

statement: The shortage is concentrated in particular SKUs

title: Where the shortage sits, by sku

claim: Short units by sku: CHG-1010 (CHG-1010): 160 units, 9.2%; CHG-1006 (CHG-1006): 150 units, 8.7%; PWB-1017 (PWB-1017): 135 units, 7.8%.

statement: Inbound purchase orders for the short SKUs are late

title: Inbound purchase orders for the short SKUs

claim: 58.4% of the short units are SKUs with a late inbound purchase order; most late units are from S-14 (Voltix Power Components), coming through Chennai. Latest: PO-40494 CHG-1001 475 units, ETA 2026-11-03 vs expected 2026-10-13 (21 days late); PO-40496 CHG-1003 150 units, ETA 2026-11-03 vs expected 2026-10-13 (21 days late); PO-40497 CHG-1004 275 units, ETA 2026-11-03 vs expected 2026-10-13 (21 days late).

statement: A disrupted port is holding the late inbound orders

title: Inbound purchase orders for the short SKUs

claim: 58.4% of the short units are SKUs whose late inbound orders come through a port the signals feed reports as disrupted. Disrupted ports: Chennai (DISRUPTED: Dock workers' strike).

statement: Demand for the short SKUs spiked above the planning baseline

title: Recent demand vs the planning baseline

claim: 40.2% of the short units are SKUs whose recent demand is at least 1.5x the planning baseline: SPK-1059 at PUN: 9.3 a day vs 0.5 (18.57x); SPL-1047 at PUN: 7.9 a day vs 0.5 (15.71x); KBM-1066 at PUN: 5.0 a day vs 0.5 (10.0x).

statement: Reorder points are too low for recent demand

claim: 33.5% of the short units are SKUs whose reorder point is below what recent demand needs: CBL-1027 at PUN reorder point 10 vs 22 needed (last reviewed 2026-08-31); CHG-1004 at PUN reorder point 292 vs 540 needed (last reviewed 2026-08-31); EBD-1032 at PUN reorder point 167 vs 277 needed (last reviewed 2026-08-31).

statement: Duplicate orders (the same external reference) inflate the numbers

claim: 1 of 29 orders in scope are extra copies of an earlier order with the same external reference (3.4%), mostly via channel PORTAL. The copies order 70 units, 4.0% as many as the 1,730 units short.

headline: 23 of the 29 open orders at the Pune DC due in the coming week have a line on backorder (79.3%). Main causes: inbound purchase orders for the short SKUs are late, held up at Chennai by a dock workers' strike (58.4% of the short units), and demand for the short SKUs spiked above the planning baseline (40.2% of the short units).
summary:
- **What happened:** 23 of the 29 open orders at the Pune DC due in the coming week have a line on backorder (79.3%): 1,730 units across 22 SKUs, worth INR 5,650,370 on backorder. [T1.A1]
- **Why:** Inbound purchase orders for the short SKUs are late, held up at Chennai by a dock workers' strike (58.4% of the short units), demand for the short SKUs spiked above the planning baseline (40.2% of the short units) and reorder points are too low for recent demand (33.5% of the short units).
- **What to do:** A1. Transfer stock to cover the S-14 shortage (62 orders; INR 22,822,365 of orders at stake; costs INR 133,590; within limits). A2. Chase the late purchase orders from Voltix Power Components and plan around Chennai (within limits).

claim: The documents report that a Chennai port strike (beginning Oct 9, indefinite) is holding Voltix vessel MV Coral Breeze at anchorage, delaying Pune DC purchase orders PO-40494 through PO-40499. Revised ETA (Oct 14 email) puts Pune DC arrival at about Nov 3, after the promised dates for next week (Oct 22-28). The Pune weather alert (Oct 19-22) explicitly states the DC remains fully operational, so weather is not the cause.
